result:
Each query is written from the documentation page alone and was not run. Two spots lean on guesses about behaviour the page doesn't show:

- **M14:** the page has no regex or replace verb, so words are split on spaces and a trailing "." or ";" is dropped.
- **M2, M8, M9, M13:** `round` is assumed to round to an integer, and `sum` of an empty vector is assumed to answer 0.

M1: filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) | * (/email | lower) | sort
M2: filter ~(/profile/age | type | eq ::number !| false) | * /profile/age | :ages / | sum | div (ages | count) | mul 10 | round | div 10
M3: filter ~(/profile/country | type | eq ::string !| false) | * (/profile/country | upper) | groupBy * count
M4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels | any ~(lower | eq "bug")) | sort ~[(/priority | mul -1) /id] | take 2 | * /id
M5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at :assignee | coalesce "unassigned") | groupBy * count
M6: * /labels | flat | * lower | distinct | sort
M7: /dependencies | entries * {:name (/0 | keyword) :version (/1 | if (startsWith "^") ~(drop 1) ~(/) | if (startsWith "~") ~(drop 1) ~(/))} | sort ~/name
M8: filter ~(/status | [(eq "paid") (eq "shipped")] | any ~(/)) | * (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
M9: filter ~(/status | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~/customer * (* (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | mul 100 | round | div 100)} | sort ~[(/total | mul -1) /customer] | take 2
M10: /services | filter ~(/tls/enabled | eq true !| false) | entries | sort ~/0 * (/1 | [/host (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join ":")
M11: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * split " " | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | * /2 | groupBy * count
M12: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(split " " | /1 | [(eq "WARN") (eq "ERROR")] | any ~(/)) | filter ~(lower | contains "timeout") | * (split " " | /2) | distinct | sort
M13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * split "," | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~/1 * (* (/2 | parseJson) | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round)
M14: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog sleeps; the fox runs. A fox is quick." | lower | split " " | * (if (endsWith ".") ~(take (count | sub 1)) ~(/) | if (endsWith ";") ~(take (count | sub 1)) ~(/)) | groupBy * count | entries * {:word (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~[(/count | mul -1) /word] | take 3
